title: Verifier agent + human review queue
description: Value-in-source grounding, schema validation, omission flags, injection detection; low-confidence/failed -> review queue, never guess. PLAN.md 2.5.
acceptance_criteria: test_prompt_injection_is_treated_as_data passes; review queue persisted and exposed via API

title: PHI agent (documents + DICOM)
description: Runs before any external call; model clients refuse un-masked payloads. Docs: layout-anchored + regex + NER detection, mask image + text. DICOM: Basic Profile header de-id, burned-in text OCR+redaction only within boxes, output valid DICOM, PatientIdentityRemoved=YES. No PHI in logs. PLAN.md 2.3.

title: Extraction agent: OCR-first vs VLM-first vs hybrid, chosen on evidence
description: Schema-valid JSON (header + Indication/Comparison/Findings/Impression) with confidence + provenance (page, bbox in original coords). Implement and compare three pipelines on dev set (EM, CER, hallucination, omission, latency, cost per tier); offline mode uses local models only (4GB GPU). PLAN.md 2.4.
acceptance_criteria: test_report_extraction_fields_and_provenance and test_provenance_maps_to_original_page_coordinates pass offline; comparison table committed under eval/results

title: Orchestrator + preprocessing agent
description: Router (fixed step) classifies DICOM/scan/photo/PDF/TIFF; planner with step limits, timeouts, retries; failures -> error JSON / review queue. Preprocessing measures quality, chooses orientation/deskew/dewarp/denoise/contrast, never overwrites source, composes transform so boxes map back to original coords. PLAN.md 2.1-2.2.
acceptance_criteria: test_input_routing and test_junk_inputs_* pass; unit test round-trips boxes through transforms within 2px

title: Near-duplicate detection + dev/golden split, DICOM selection + GT
description: MinHash/LSH dedup groups; split by report into dev and frozen golden (>=100 pages) stratified by tier, groups never cross; save IDs/seeds/method. Select >=40 DICOM across modalities incl burned-in text; derive header + burned-in GT from curated counterpart; document derivation + incompleteness. PLAN.md 1.4-1.5.
acceptance_criteria: splits/ committed with SPLIT.md; test asserting no dup group crosses; golden list hash-locked; dicom GT + notes committed

title: Report rendering, handwriting, degradation tiers, adversarial pages, GT with bboxes
description: Render >=300 IU reports (Faker seed 140 header, exam table, sections, multi-page); >=30% pages with handwritten fields; 3 tiers clean/poor/photo with rotation 90/180, skew, warp, blur, noise, low DPI, JPEG, lighting, stamps; PNG/JPEG + multi-page PDF + TIFF; >=10 injected pages; per-field GT incl. bbox transformed through every geometric op. PLAN.md 1.2-1.3.
acceptance_criteria: Reproducible generation command; GT json per doc; unit test that transformed GT boxes land on the rendered text; overlay sample images for report

title: Data acquisition + audit (IU Open-i, TCIA Pseudo-PHI-DICOM)
description: Scripted, checksummed download of IU reports/images and Pseudo-PHI-DICOM (PHI + curated sets + mapping). Riskiest external dependency - do first. Audit report sections, XXXX tokens, normal-report share, MeSH frequencies into data_prep/audit.md. See requirements.md constraints 3-4 and PLAN.md 1.1.
acceptance_criteria: make/CLI command downloads both datasets into gitignored data/ with manifest+sha256; audit.md committed; no licensed data in git

title: Final golden run, report (DOCX/PDF) and README
description: Run golden set once, commit traces/final, rescore from traces; report with architecture diagram, results tables overall+per tier, pipeline comparison, chronological steps incl failures, PHI residual cases, injection results, error analysis, best/median/worst overlays, DICOM before/after, tech details, trace screenshots; README per requirements.md.
acceptance_criteria: report file in report/; README reproduces every number; no licensed data or PHI committed

title: Deployment: FastAPI + Docker Compose + batch CLI + ops
description: POST /cases, GET /cases/{id}, GET /review-queue, POST /query, GET /health; docker compose up one command; batch CLI on unseen folder per schemas/cli_output.v1.json; structured PHI-free logs; requirements.lock pinned; healthchecks; clear errors. PLAN.md P5.
acceptance_criteria: full tests/integration suite passes offline; deploy.md smoke test passes incl compose /health

title: Retrieval / QA agent with citations and abstention
description: Hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval over verified extractions; answers cite case/doc, page, bbox; citation quotes verified; abstain on weak evidence; document text treated as data. PLAN.md P4.
acceptance_criteria: test_api_e2e::test_upload_query_and_review_flow passes; recall@5, citation accuracy, correctness, abstention reported

title: Tracing, versioning, evaluation harness, golden QA set, CI regression gate
description: Replayable JSONL traces; rescore from traces with model calls forbidden (radintake.eval.rescore); versioned prompts/schemas/model ids recorded in traces; all metrics from requirements.md; >=25 golden QA incl >=5 unanswerable; eval gate (radintake.eval.gate --subset ci) vs eval/baseline.json in GitHub Actions; one intentional failing gate commit followed by fix; error analysis of 10 worst golden pages. PLAN.md P3.
acceptance_criteria: test_traces_written_and_replayable passes; CI runs gate; intentional red commit visible in history

title: Bonus: LoRA/QLoRA fine-tune small OCR/VLM
description: Fine-tune Florence-2-base or TrOCR (fits 4GB) on dev data; compare with base and best pipeline on quality, latency, cost. PLAN.md P6.
acceptance_criteria: comparison table in report; weights shared by link, not committed
